title: corniola triangularis
intro: Corniola triangularis, commonly known as Cornu Zebrawood, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae, native to India. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce fever and alleviate respiratory issues. These bioactive compounds have been known to exhibit antimicrobial, antiparasitic, and antiviral activities, making the plant a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
